assets.usedIn: Turn a percentage into a harvest date
assets.caption: Melon planted on Summer 1: days removed are ceil(12 × effective modifier), so the base growth days multiplied by the modifier are rounded up; the modifier itself is not rounded up.
assets.alt: Melon planted on Summer 1 with base stage vector 1, 2, 3, 3, 3 and four calculated states: no fertilizer remains 12 days and harvests Summer 13; Speed-Gro becomes 1, 1, 2, 3, 3 for 10 days and Summer 11; Deluxe Speed-Gro becomes 1, 1, 2, 2, 3 for 9 days and Summer 10; Hyper Speed-Gro becomes 1, 1, 2, 2, 2 for 8 days and Summer 9. Days removed are ceil(12 times the effective modifier), not a rounded modifier.

assets.caption: Strawberry planted on Spring 13: fertilizer changes the initial growth segment, while every later harvest follows the crop's fixed four-day regrowth interval. Spring 29 is outside the 28-day season.
assets.alt: Strawberry planted on Spring 13: no fertilizer harvests Spring 21 and 25 with the next Spring 29 outside the season; Speed-Gro harvests Spring 20, 24, and 28; Deluxe Speed-Gro harvests Spring 19, 23, and 27; Hyper Speed-Gro harvests Spring 18, 22, and 26. Each later interval is four days.
